description:
## Kero309x Patches 0.1.2 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. Anghami 8.0.28 is the first registered target on the Morphe framework.

- First release built by `buildAndroid`, so the bundle carries `classes.dex` and can be loaded by Morphe Manager. Releases `0.1.0` and `0.1.1` were built without DEX and only serve Morphe Desktop.
- First signed release. The `.mpp` carries an Ed25519 signature in its `MorpheSig1` trailer, and `patches-bundle.json` publishes the matching `public_key`, so a bundle altered after publication can be rejected.
- No behaviour change to any of the twenty patches.

### Verification

- 20 patches, all default-enabled.
- 20/20 PASS against the stock 8.0.28 build (fingerprint, apply and recompile).
- Published artefact re-checked after the release: 112 entries, `classes.dex` of 99,480 bytes, a signature whose public key equals the committed `morphe-signing.pub`, and a SHA-256 matching the value below.
- No device or emulator is available yet, so there is no runtime behavioural verification.

### Install

Add `Kero309x/Kero309x-Patches` as a patch source in Morphe Manager and enable pre-releases, or install the attached `Kero309x-Patches-0.1.2.mpp` directly.

### Integrity

SHA-256: `47B177D75EF06CA5E34497B8005DB0415B57A10C9A5C41B7F049C127BE6FEDFD`

Licence: GPL-3.0-only.

patches.name: Block ads between tracks
patches.description: Stops the player from inserting audio and video advertisements between tracks.

patches.name: Unlimited track skips
patches.description: Removes the client-side limit on skipping tracks.

patches.name: Unlock lyrics
patches.description: Opens the lyrics screen for every account instead of showing the subscription prompt.

patches.name: Disable forced shuffle
patches.description: Plays a list in its own order instead of turning it into a shuffled radio queue for accounts without Plus.

patches.name: Hide shuffle badges
patches.description: Stops list cards, rows and headers from drawing the badge that marks shuffled playback.

patches.name: Hide premium feature buttons
patches.description: Stops the player and the queue rows from drawing the karaoke upsell button.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Stops the player, the live radio screen and the main screen from marking their windows as secure, so screenshots and screen recording capture them.

patches.name: Show profile Plus badge
patches.description: Draws the subscription badge on your own profile and on the account row without changing what the account is entitled to.

patches.name: Plus entitlement state
patches.description: Reports the account as a paying subscriber to every local check that derives that state.

patches.name: Hide Gold upsell
patches.description: Hides the Gold call to action that section headers can show.

patches.name: Hide upgrade banners
patches.description: Removes the navigation entry, promo bar, feed cells, downloads notice and settings or library rows that advertise a subscription upgrade.

patches.name: Lift download limits
patches.description: Stops the client refusing downloads because of the plan check, the collection restriction or the offline count.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops the app starting its analytics, attribution and crash reporting SDKs and sending events to them.

patches.name: Hide sponsored content
patches.description: Removes the sponsored label from song rows and cards, and the sponsor banner from the in-car screen.

patches.name: Block promotional popups
patches.description: Stops the popup and full-screen promotional overlays from being drawn over the app.

patches.name: Disable the rating prompt
patches.description: Stops Anghami from asking you to rate the app, in both its own dialog and the Play review sheet.

patches.name: Stock signature assertion
patches.description: Derives the request signature from the store build's certificate instead of the installed one.

patches.name: Hide in-feed ad banners
patches.description: Stops lists from inserting advertising banners between their cells.

patches.name: Ignore the forced update requirement
patches.description: Stops the client from showing the blocking update dialog when the server marks this build as outdated.

patches.name: Disable first-party Silo telemetry
patches.description: Stops the application reporting playback, navigation and device data to Anghami's own Silo telemetry.
